guards.step_title: Payment screen (booking, edit surcharge, SOS, restore)

guards.customer_sees: Success page, 'Platba se ověřuje' page or 'Změna už neplatí' sheet with 'Načíst znovu'.

guards.step_title: Payment screen (booking, edit surcharge, SOS, restore)

guards.customer_sees: Toast 'Potvrzeno' then the success page, or an error sheet.

merged_situations.situation: A free booking is confirmed only when the server really marks it paid; otherwise the error is shown (no fake success).

guards.step_title: Payment screen (booking, edit surcharge, SOS, restore)
guards.situation: An edit surcharge or bike swap counts as paid only when the server has applied the change (new total_price) - not because the original booking is 'paid'; the change is queued so it completes even if the app is killed; an amount up to 1 Kč is applied by the server without payment.
guards.customer_sees: 'Hotovo', 'Úprava se dokončuje' or 'Platba nebyla dokončena' result page.
